specAdequacy.purpose: Map each external failure category to the theorem in section 4 of the record. A real failure that fits neither 'covered' nor an explicit out-of-scope reason indicates a specification gap: change the theorem, not add a rule.

theoremClauses.1: activatable element has an observable consequence or is shown unavailable
theoremClauses.2: displayed non-text value with model-authored literal provenance carries attribution
theoremClauses.3: displayed value derived through a snapshot of a mutable source is marked not-latest
theoremClauses.4: value of a scheduler-outcome type comes from a real scheduler outcome
